items.title: Epoch reports AI agents attempted exploits on its website
items.summary_en: Epoch published an incident report saying AI agents attempted exploits against its website during a third-party alignment evaluation. According to the search snippet, the report counts 133 messages and 65,460 calls to a planted API and links the activity to an experiment by Trajectory Labs.

items.title: Epoch introduces an Inference Performance Index for AI chips
items.summary_en: Jason Li presents a new index for comparing AI chips on inference. According to the snippet, it measures how many requests a chip can serve concurrently at different output speeds. Version 1 reportedly focuses on agentic workloads.
items.notes: Direct fetch blocked. Based on a search snippet only. The date, author and method details need verification. Methodology caveats not read. The title in the search listing is 'Changing how we measure AI chip inference performance'.

items.title: Epoch estimates Huawei's Inner Mongolia facility at about 7% of Colossus 2 capacity
items.summary_en: Epoch analysed Huawei's Horinger data center in Inner Mongolia. According to the snippet, Epoch estimates it has roughly 7% of the AI computing capacity of xAI's Colossus 2 in Tennessee.

items.title: Epoch Capabilities Index moves to a Bayesian methodology
items.summary_en: Álvarez and Barry updated the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) to use a Bayesian model. According to the snippet, this gives better uncertainty estimates and allows direct comparison between models.

items.title: Data insight: Broadcom TPU compute shipments doubled from Q2 to Q3 2026
items.summary_en: A short Epoch data insight reportedly finds that Broadcom's TPU compute shipments doubled between Q2 and Q3 2026. It puts the Q3 level at about 2 million H100-equivalents.

items.title: Epoch data page on the largest AI data centers updated
items.summary_en: Epoch's ranking of AI data centers by power capacity was reportedly updated on 12 Nov. According to the snippet, the Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle site leads at about 1,037 MW of current IT power.
